name: grid-1fr-risks
notes: Sub-check 2.5 — CSS grid 1fr collapse audit. A bare `1fr` track collapses to its content's intrinsic minimum width (which can be 0 for empty cells, or the longest unbreakable token like a long URL). Risk pattern: `grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr` with no min-width. SAFE patterns we found: (a) `repeat(auto-fill, minmax(Npx, 1fr))` — 9 occurrences, all proper; (b) `1fr` inside @media (max-width: ...) where it's the desired single-column collapse — 13 occurrences, all proper; (c) `Npx 1fr auto` with a fixed leading track — 11 occurrences, the 1fr is the content area between fixed sidebars, won't collapse below content. ZERO bare-1fr cases. Phase 3a/3b/3d/3e blocks did NOT introduce any new grid-template-columns declarations: `src/blocks/pro-*/style.css` files only ship visibility-modifier rules (`.mvs-hide-{tablet,mobile}`); all feed-grid CSS lives in `templates/layouts/<slug>/<slug>.css` (pre-existing) and was already proper before 1.2.0. The `assets/css/gamification.css` file (1.2.0 owns) has 19 grid declarations all using the safe patterns. No findings.
